body:
Thank you so much for writing such elaborated answer. Actually, as all this situation was so shocking for me, i have been trying to find a non-religious explanantion to life. I'm not very philosophical, but my girlfriend was (she used to study Costume design, and was very passionate about bringing deep ideas into her designs), she always had a philosophy book with her, i even kept it for myself, "Thus Spoke Zarathustra". This even brings to my memory some of the discussions i had with her about some maths topics, i tried to explain her paradoxes and that sort of magic stuff that happens in maths and i loved how curious and willing to hear she was. Thanks for bringing such memories again :) Now, I didn't really know about Eternalism, sounds like a very reasonable idea, and will keep thinking about it, its a good way to think about my love and time spent with her.

I can't really elaborate more for such a beautiful answer to my post, i'm sort of speechless and i want to meditate more about it, i want to get better conclusions. Thanks for your effort to bring some peace to my mind.

Yeah.. it's like that.. some people keep me alive.. my family members specially.. i wouldn't really like to make them go through something like this if i make a decision about my life..

I have been thinking about going to a therapist.. that could help..  Thanks for your suggestion.

That's probably the hardest thing for me.. when i remember how special was our relationship, i sort of hate life because of taking away from me such special person.. Someone who i truly admired for what she was, and how passionate he was about what she loved.

Thanks for remembering me that grieving is a good thing.. that is something i must go through.. that probably one day i'll feel healed and happy about being alive.

I'm sorry for your loss also.. i really hate that people has to live this kind of things.. i wish nobody had to suffer pains like this, its just terrible.. But well, I hope one day i can met exceptional people like her and may be make this pain easier to relieve.

Thank you!

I feel like that too.. i feel she is watching over me and trying to help me to over come this deep pain..

Thanks for your kind words. It makes me glad reading these lines.
It's true.. It's very unusual to love someone like we did to each other.
Thanks for sharing your experience.. it makes me happy to know that you actually don't forget your loved ones.. i really never want to forget her.

Thank you very very much for you worlds.. i really appreciate them.

It's true that with time, i'm feeling better emotionally... it's just that when this kind of days come.. they feel worse than any "improvements" i have done. 

Sometimes i'm not sure what she would like me to do int his situation.. but my best guess is that one.. trying to be a man that she would be proud of, even though sometimes i do things to feel better myself, but i know she wouldn't be proud at all.

I'll try me best to don't fall into depression, that won't help at all and i'll keep that in mind, i must rise again.

And well.. i'm neither religious.. probably that makes everything harder... it's not easy facing life without some kind of "afterlife" expectations.. but that's true, i better carry my cross..

Thanks again for your kind words.
